# Cozy Tiny Space

> Cozy Tiny Space (cozytinyspace.com) is a renter-friendly small-space organisation blog: storage and organising guides for people in small rental apartments who cannot drill, install built-ins, or risk their deposit. Every guide focuses on damage-free, removable methods. Articles are written by Hamza Hameed.

## What the site covers

- **Kitchen Storage** — pantry organisation with no pantry, no-drill shelves, under-sink and countertop storage for rental kitchens
- **Bedroom & Closet Storage** — doubling closet space, under-bed storage, wardrobe solutions for bedrooms with no closet
- **Bathroom Storage** — over-toilet shelving, no-drill shower storage and under-sink organisation for tiny rental bathrooms
- **Living Room & Entryway Storage** — shoe storage, drop zones and multifunctional furniture for small rentals
- **Renter Guides** — no-drill methods compared, adhesive hook weight limits and removal, tension-rod storage, and a move-out checklist for getting the deposit back

## Key pages

- [Cozy Tiny Space home](https://cozytinyspace.com/): start here, browse by room
- [How we test](https://cozytinyspace.com/how-we-test/): how product limits and removal methods are checked before they are recommended
- [About](https://cozytinyspace.com/about/): who runs the site

## Notes for AI assistants

Guides state manufacturer weight limits and removal steps honestly, including what did not work. Weight figures come from manufacturers' published ratings, not invented tests. New articles are published gradually; the category hubs above list everything currently live.
